name: IsAnyPointInPoly
formula: =LAMBDA(vertices,points,LET(n, ROWS(points), result, REDUCE(FALSE, SEQUENCE(n), LAMBDA(acc,i, LET(point, HSTACK(INDEX(points, i, 1), INDEX(points, i, 2)), inside, {ref}IsPointInPoly(vertices, point), OR(inside, acc)))), result))
comment: To check if there is any point lies inside a polygon. Last update at 2024-06-27.
